home.title: MigraAid
home.tagline: Understand your rights in Singapore — in your language.
home.disclaimer: MigraAid gives general information, not legal advice. For your specific situation, contact a caseworker at a partner organisation. In an emergency, use the Emergency Contacts page.

chat.title: Ask MigraAid
chat.empty: Ask about your rights, pay, housing, healthcare, or paperwork.
chat.escalatedNotice: This looks serious. Please contact a caseworker at a partner organisation.
chat.error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.

emergency.title: Emergency contacts
emergency.intro: If you are in danger, call 999 (Police) or 995 (Ambulance/Fire) now.
emergency.verifyNote: Please confirm these numbers are current before relying on them.
